summary: Frontend-only test of the new project detail pages (3), film pages (9), recruiter summary, YouTube switch and sitemap. Static SEO check passes on all 13 new pages: 1 h1 each, no skipped heading levels, unique titles of 40-58 chars, descriptions of 122-159 chars, canonical and og:url match the page URL, valid JSON-LD. Projects have a CreativeWork mainEntity. Films have a VideoObject with contentUrl, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate and a PTnMnS duration. Projects and films have a 3-level BreadcrumbList. The recruiter page has 2 levels (Home > Recruiter Summary), which is correct because it has no parent. nav-recruiter-cta and footer-link-recruiter are present on all 22 pages and point to /recruiter-summary.html. All 63 internal refs resolve. sitemap.xml has 22 URLs, 9 with video:video; every loc, content_loc and thumbnail_loc returns 200. The résumé PDF returns 200 application/pdf. Playwright: projects.html has 3 cards, and the title link and 'Read the full project' link open the same detail page. On detail pages the GitHub button opens github.com/Jackie-legit in a new tab, the contact button goes to /contact.html, breadcrumb-parent goes to /projects.html, and next/prev cycle and wrap. Training films: all 9 film-page-link-i are correct, and clicking film-media-0 still adds video.film-fullvideo. Film pages have video[data-testid=film-page-video] with controls, a poster and an mp4 source, list 8 film-more-* links (not itself), and the pager cycles through all 9 and wraps. YouTube switch, tested by injecting data-youtube through route interception: the click adds iframe.film-fullvideo with the youtube-nocookie embed, and other films still play mp4. Recruiter page: all 8 sections render, the mailto/tel links are correct, the résumé button downloads resume-jacqueline-magawa.pdf, the 3 project links point to the detail pages, and the stubbed window.print is called exactly once per click and per Enter key. With print media emulated, nav, footer, breadcrumb, back-to-top and .no-print buttons are hidden, and the rendered PDF contains all sections. No horizontal overflow at 390, 768 or 1280 on the new pages or on regression pages. Regression checks pass: seo_static_check (only the known /%2e%2e 400 from the ingress), gallery lightbox open/next/Escape with overflow restored, contact resume modal open/iframe/close, native required-field validation on empty submit (the real form was not submitted), mobile hamburger, and all old pages return 200 with 1 h1. No JS page errors. The main issue is the desktop nav: it fits on one row at 1280 and 1440, but wraps at 1025-1200 and at 1366, and the CTA is clipped at about 1025-1100.

ui_bugs.issue: Nav links wrap onto 2 lines ('FLIGHT / LOG', 'TRAINING / FILMS') at widths 1025-1200px and 1281-~1420px (confirmed at 1366, a very common laptop width; link height 54px vs 29px). At 1025-~1100px the 'Recruiter view' CTA is pushed past the viewport (CTA right edge is 1097px at a 1025px viewport) and gets clipped. Root cause: .nav-link has no white-space:nowrap, and the only compression rule is @media (max-width:1280px) (gap 18px, 12.5px font). Above 1280 the full 14px font, 1.68px letter-spacing, 26px gap and the 26px CTA margin are too wide until ~1420px, and below ~1200 even the compressed size does not fit. Fix: add white-space:nowrap to .nav-link, extend the compression breakpoint to ~1440px, and add a tighter tier for 1025-1200 (e.g. 12px gap, 11.5px font, smaller CTA padding), or switch to the hamburger at <=1200px.

issues: The 'one-page' summary prints on 2 Letter pages: Projects and Flight training highlights move to page 2, leaving ~25% of page 1 empty. Tighten the print typography and spacing (e.g. smaller block padding and 10pt body) so it fits on one page.

The .reveal transition still runs in print media: just after switching to print, the off-screen .reveal blocks compute opacity 0 and fade in over 0.7s. Chrome's PDF output was fine, but add 'transition:none !important' to the print .reveal rule to be safe across browsers.
The film player is 1376x774 and starts at y=366, so its bottom edge and the native controls are below the fold. Consider max-height: ~70vh on .film-player / .film-feature.

nav-recruiter-cta is hidden at <=1024px and the hamburger menu has no recruiter link, so on mobile and tablet the summary is only reachable from the footer. Consider adding 'Recruiter view' as the last item in the mobile menu.

action_items: Fix desktop nav wrapping/clipping between 1025-1200px and 1281-1420px (white-space:nowrap on .nav-link plus adjusted breakpoints)
Optional: make the recruiter print fit on one page and disable .reveal transitions in @media print
Optional: cap the film player height to ~70vh on desktop
Optional: add a Recruiter view link to the mobile hamburger menu
critical_code_review_comments: Film page titles use the generic suffix '| Flight Training Video' without the name, so titles are close to each other ('Mid-Air Training | ...' vs 'Mid-Air Training & Cruising | ...'). Consider '<film> | Jacqueline Magawa' when it fits in 60 chars.
The recruiter page WebPage has no mainEntity. Add mainEntity {@id: #person} (or use ProfilePage) to tie the page to the Person entity.

YouTube branch: the VideoObject switches to embedUrl (youtube.com/embed) and drops contentUrl, and the sitemap uses player_loc. That is consistent and valid. The JS embed uses youtube-nocookie, which is fine.
Builds are deterministic: rerunning build_site.py produced no diff. bluehost/js-main-bluehost.js still matches js/main.js except for CONTACT_ENDPOINT.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional checks pass; 1 responsive nav bug + minor design items)

seed_data_creation: None. The contact form was not submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run python3 /app/tests/seo_detail_pages_check.py (new pages, JSON-LD, CTA on every page, 22-URL sitemap with video entries) and /app/tests/seo_static_check.py (the /%2e%2e 400 from the ingress is expected). To test the YouTube switch without editing data.json, use page.route on training-films.html to inject data-youtube on a .film-media. To check nav fit, measure #navLinks a heights at 1100, 1366 and 1280 (single line is about 29-31px; wrapped is 49-54px). .reveal elements need ~1s before screenshots or they look blank.
